fee_notes: Royalty is 6% of Gross Revenue, paid bi-weekly. Brand Fund Contribution is 3% of Gross Revenue (beginning 9th month after opening), paid bi-weekly with royalty; franchisor reserves right to increase up to 4%. Social Media and Website Management fee is currently $350/month. Technology Fee is currently $550/month (includes POS software, email, network support, software licenses). Rapid Response fee currently $109/month. Local Advertisement requirement is the greater of 3% of Gross Revenue or $2,000/month; if minimum not met, difference is remitted to Brand Fund. Various conditional/special circumstance fees also apply (training, transfer, renewal, audit, default, etc.).
raw_excerpt:
Royalty | 6% of Gross Revenue(2) | Bi-weekly | The Royalty fee is based on Gross Revenue during the previous month...
Brand Fund Contribution (3) | 3% of Gross Revenues | Bi-weekly, with Royalty | Beginning the 9th month after you open your Franchised Business, you must contribute 3% of your Gross Revenue to the "Brand Fund." We reserve the right to increase this contribution up to 4%.
Social Media and Website Management (4) | Currently $350 per month | Due on the 15th of each month | Collected for each Franchised Business to pay for certain social media and website management services and web landing page optimization services.
Technology Fee (5) | Currently $550 per month | Due on the 15th of each month | We may change or update software and you must pay for updates, new software, or increases from third-party vendors. The "Technology Fee" includes the POS software, email, and network support along with additional software licenses for outbound consumer messaging and electronic forms.
Rapid Response | Currently $109 per month | Due on the 15th of each month | You must retain the designated vendor and use its services when investigating potential violations of our then-current conduct policy.
Local Advertisement Payment (4) | The greater of 3% of Gross Revenue or $2,000 per month | As incurred | If you fail to spend your "Minimum Local Advertisement Requirement" on local advertising each month, you must pay us the difference between the amount you spent and the Minimum Local Advertisement Requirement, which will be contributed to the Brand Fund.
